tenderSchedule.title: PROCUREMENT OF SPARES FOR CWP,ACW & DMCW PUMPS
tenderSchedule.description: PROCUREMENT OF SPARES FOR CWP,ACW & DMCW PUMPS
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

The bidder should have supplied Spares for horizontal/vertical pumps like CWP/ACW/DMCW/Rawater Pumps to power plant/process industries/reputed organization of value Rs. 18.15 lakhs or above in a single order during preceding five financial years. As a proof furnish signed past Purchase Order copies placed by any Govt. sector/ PSU/ Reputed Private sector/ major industry
The bidder shall be Manufacturer / Supplier of Pump spares for 210MW or above thermal power plant. The Agency shall furnish documentary proof

Bidder should have proven financial capability and have an average annual turnover of Rs. 36.30 lakhs for any two years among preceding five financial years. The bidder shall furnish a copy of turnover certificate / Profit and loss statement duly certified by a charted accountant to establish annual turnover requirement stipulated above

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed
